title: Billing, Payment and Penalty Fee Terms by Card - Larkspur Credit Cards
content:
The table below gives the billing and payment terms and the penalty fee amounts of the Larkspur Credit Cards. Dollar amounts are in USD.

| Term | Larkspur Secured Visa | Larkspur Classic Visa | Larkspur Cash Back Visa | Larkspur Balance Transfer Visa Platinum | Larkspur Cash Back Visa Signature | Larkspur Travel Rewards Visa Signature |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum payment percent of the statement balance (added to that cycle's interest and fees) | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Lowest minimum payment (or the full balance if smaller) | 35 | 35 | 35 | 35 | 35 | 35 |
| Days from statement closing to the payment due date | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 |
| Late fee, first late payment | 32 | 32 | 32 | 32 | 32 | 32 |
| Late fee, another late payment within the next six billing cycles | 43 | 43 | 43 | 43 | 43 | 43 |
| Returned-payment fee, first returned payment | 32 | 32 | 32 | 32 | 32 | 32 |
| Returned-payment fee, another returned payment within the next six billing cycles | 43 | 43 | 43 | 43 | 43 | 43 |
| Courtesy reversals of a late or returned-payment fee per account in any rolling 12 months | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |

**How payments are applied (identical on every card).** The minimum payment goes to balances in any order Larkspur chooses (lowest APR first). Any amount above the minimum goes to the highest-APR balance first.

**Cap on the penalty fees.** Each late fee and each returned-payment fee, whether at the first or the repeat amount, is never more than the minimum payment due.

## Points of reading

- **The only term that differs by card** is the courtesy reversal allowance. It is 2 per rolling 12 months on the Larkspur Cash Back Visa Signature and the Larkspur Travel Rewards Visa Signature, and 1 on the other four cards.
- **"Within the next six billing cycles."** A late fee is charged at 43 instead of 32 only when it is another late payment within the next six billing cycles after an earlier one. The same applies to the returned-payment fee.
- **The floor.** A minimum payment is never lower than 35, unless the full balance is smaller than 35, in which case the full balance is the floor.
